records.source: Hmm... this green jelly has a minty flavor to it.$3#$b#I wonder how mint became associated with the Feast Of The Winter Star? Does mint even grow in Winter?$3
records.translation: Hmm... may lasang menta ang berdeng halayang ito.$3#$b#Paano kaya naiugnay ang menta sa Piging ng Bituin ng Taglamig? Tumutubo ba ang menta sa taglamig?$3

records.source: It's pretty chilly today. Good thing everyone here is bundled up.$0
records.translation: Medyo maginaw ngayon. Mabuti na lang at makakapal ang suot ng lahat dito.$0

records.source: One benefit of the cold weather is that I can put frozen pizzas under the tree.#$e#Someone's in for a real treat...$h
records.translation: Isang pakinabang ng malamig na panahon ay maaari kong ilagay sa ilalim ng puno ang mga nakapirming pizza.#$e#May isang taong makatatanggap ng napakasarap na regalo...$h

records.source: I guess it's nice the whole family is together for once.$7
records.translation: Mukhang maganda ring minsang magkasama-sama ang buong pamilya.$7

records.source: Need any last minute gifts? I've got you covered! Take a look at my wares.$0
records.translation: Kailangan mo ba ng pahabol na regalo? Ako ang bahala! Tingnan mo ang mga paninda ko.$0

records.source: Isn't the tree gorgeous?$h#$b#I spent all morning decorating it with Marnie and Jodi. It's a fun tradition!
records.translation: Hindi ba napakaganda ng puno?$h#$b#Buong umaga ko itong pinalamutian kasama sina Marnie at Jodi. Masayang tradisyon ito!

records.source: The mayor personally invited me to his table. I couldn't turn that down!
records.translation: Personal akong inanyayahan ng Alkalde sa hapag niya. Hindi ko iyon maaaring tanggihan!

records.source: I'm pretty sure there's a gridball-shaped present with my name on it underneath the spirit tree.$1
records.translation: Tiyak akong may regalong hugis-gridball na may pangalan ko sa ilalim ng punong-espiritu.$1

records.source: I already spend all day with the family, anyway. Why do we need a big hubbub out in the cold?$0
records.translation: Buong araw ko namang kasama ang pamilya. Bakit kailangan pa natin ng malaking kaguluhan sa labas sa gitna ng lamig?$0

records.source: You are more than welcome to join us at our table, dear.$0
records.translation: Malugod kang makisalo sa hapag namin, mahal.$0

records.source: Happy Feast Of The Winter Star, @.$h#$e#This is a time to unwind, enjoy good company, and express gratitude for all that we have.$0
records.translation: Maligayang Piging ng Bituin ng Taglamig, @.$h#$e#Panahon ito para magpahinga, masiyahan sa mabuting samahan, at ipahayag ang pasasalamat sa lahat ng mayroon tayo.$0

records.source: I could use some new blacksmithing tools. Mine have gotten a little rusty over the years.$0
records.translation: Kailangan ko ng mga bagong kasangkapan sa pagpapanday. Medyo kinakalawang na ang mga gamit ko sa paglipas ng mga taon.$0

records.source: Look! It's the 'Winter Star'!%noturn$6#$e#Oh, my mistake. It's just a decoration!$h
records.translation: Tingnan mo! Ang 'Bituin ng Taglamig'!%noturn$6#$e#Oh, nagkamali ako. Dekorasyon lang pala!$h

records.source: $y 'Hello, @. What kind of gift are you hoping to receive this year?_An iridium milk pail_Oh? I've never heard of such a thing. It sounds expensive._An interesting book_Yes, a book can make a very nice gift!$h_A lump of coal_...I can't tell if you're joking, but that could be a useful gift!$h'
records.translation: $y 'Kumusta, @. Anong uri ng regalo ang inaasahan mong matanggap ngayong taon?_Isang Timba ng Gatas na Iridyum_Oh? Hindi pa ako nakarinig ng ganoon. Mukhang mahal iyon._Isang kawili-wiling aklat_Oo, maaaring napakagandang regalo ang aklat!$h_Isang tipak ng uling_...Hindi ko malaman kung nagbibiro ka, pero maaari iyong maging kapaki-pakinabang na regalo!$h'

records.source: Mulled wine is the only thing keepin' me warm in this freezing weather!$h
records.translation: Mainit na alak na may rekado lang ang nagpapainit sa akin sa napakaginaw na panahong ito!$h

records.source: It's so pretty... I wish our town could always look like this!$0
records.translation: Napakaganda... Sana laging ganito ang hitsura ng bayan natin!$0

records.source: This spot is for the overflow presents. There's just too many to count this year!$0
records.translation: Para sa mga sobrang regalo ang puwestong ito. Napakarami ngayong taon at hindi na mabilang!$0

records.source: Seeing my little boy happy and healthy is what I'm thankful for.$h
records.translation: Ipinagpapasalamat kong makitang masaya at malusog ang munting anak kong lalaki.$h

records.source: Who gifts someone a Joja basket?...$2
records.translation: Sino ang nagbibigay ng basket ng Joja bilang regalo?...$2

records.source: Sometimes I dread going to parties, but afterwards I'm always glad I went!
records.translation: Kung minsan, kinatatamaran kong pumunta sa mga pagtitipon, pero pagkatapos ay lagi akong natutuwang pumunta ako!

records.source: Happy Feasting, @!$1
records.translation: Maligayang Piging, @!$1

records.source: *urp*$8#$b#Ahh... excuse me. Where are my manners? This spiced cider has quite a potent fizz to it.$4
records.translation: *dighay*$8#$b#Ahh... paumanhin. Nasaan ang kagandahang-asal ko? Napakalakas ng bula ng cider na ito na may rekado.$4

records.source: Eat! Eat, while it's still fresh and hot.$0#$e#I could go on and on about my new method of making candy canes... but I'll spare you the details this year!$1
records.translation: Kumain! Kumain habang sariwa at mainit pa.$0#$e#Maaari kong ikuwento nang walang tigil ang bago kong paraan ng paggawa ng mga baston na kendi... pero hindi ko na iyon ikukuwento nang detalyado ngayong taon!$1

records.source: I'm a simple man, @... I'm thankful for a solid roof over me head, and a hot can o' beans in the mornin'!$h
records.translation: Simple akong tao, @... Nagpapasalamat ako sa matibay na bubong sa ibabaw ng ulo ko at mainit na latang beans sa umaga!$h

records.source: Ah, the mysterious Winter Star. One of the reasons I chose this valley as the location for my... research.
records.translation: Ah, ang mahiwagang Bituin ng Taglamig. Isa sa mga dahilan kung bakit pinili ko ang lambak na ito bilang lugar ng aking... pananaliksik.

records.source: Have you tried the pecan pie? It's my favorite.$0
records.translation: Natikman mo na ba ang pie na pecan? Paborito ko iyon.$0

records.source: Is it time to open presents yet?$0
records.translation: Oras na ba para buksan ang mga regalo?$0

records.source: I got the toy dinosaur I wanted! See!?$1#$e#It's called um... a ste-...stego-...stegosonaurus! ...I think.$0
records.translation: Nakuha ko ang laruang dinosauro na gusto ko! Kita mo!?$1#$e#Ang tawag dito ay um... ste-...stego-...stegosonaurus! ...Sa tingin ko.$0

records.source: Hmm? Oh, hello.$0#$e#Don't pay any mind to me. Go enjoy yourself.
records.translation: Hmm? Oh, kumusta.$0#$e#Huwag mo akong alalahanin. Magsaya ka.

records.source: I don't know what most of this stuff is... but it tastes good!$0
records.translation: Hindi ko alam kung ano ang karamihan sa mga ito... pero masarap!$0
